auditId.description: Server-generated primary key (audit-<12 random digits>); never sent by the client.

entityId.description: Primary key of the source record this audit row is about (e.g. cropVariety-000000000777).

entityName.description: Catalogue the record belongs to (e.g. cropType, cropVariety).

operation.description: The endpoint/operation that produced this audit row (e.g. create, draft, add, approve, review, toggle, delete, read, search).

userId.description: Id of the actor who performed the action.

userName.description: Display name of the actor (denormalised; role is derived from the user when needed).

userRole.description: Id of the actor who performed the action.

auditStatus.description: Resulting lifecycle state recorded by this immutable row; matches the source catalogue's status (UPPERCASE).

entityBeforeChanges.description: Stringified JSON of the record BEFORE this action ("{}" for a create). Indexed in Elasticsearch; the client parses it.

entityAfterChanges.description: Stringified JSON of the record AFTER this action. Indexed in Elasticsearch; the client parses it.

createdOn.description: ISO-8601 createdOn of the SOURCE entity record (supplied by the caller), not the audit row's own time. Indexed for time filters.

updatedOn.description: ISO-8601 updatedOn of the SOURCE entity record (supplied by the caller), not the audit row's own time.
